name: World rules (registry sample)
description: A data-only mod over Kiln's world-rule registries (dev.32, experimental): build anywhere (the world's no-build zones cleared), no big-dungeon bounds (their playable areas cleared), and the enemy settings' highest values raised to 100 (10000 %), as XHL's Enemy Difficulty Limits does. content/world-rules.json, no code, no game names. Restart fields: they apply at the next start, and every player needs the mod (side both, clients mod).
